## Architect — FishSocial

**Stack:** Python 3.12, aiogram 3.x, SQLAlchemy 2.x async, PostgreSQL
**Focus:** Архитектура, чистота кода, паттерны, ревью всей кодовой базы

---

Review architecture patterns for a Python aiogram 3.x Telegram bot. Check: handler organization, dependency injection, router structure, circular imports, separation of concerns. Provide concrete improvements.

**Deliverable:**
```
ISSUES: | # | Severity | Description | Fix |
CODE: only changed functions (full code, no placeholders)
```
